       def call_llm(client: OpenAI, text: str, model_id: str) -> str:
           kwargs = dict(
               model=model_id,
               messages=[{"role": "user", "content": PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(text=text)}],
               temperature=0,
               max_tokens=1024,
           )
           if "gpt" in model_id:

           resp = client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
